name: courier-file-icons
description: Courier's own icons for courier.config.ts, courier.mocks.ts and the .courier folder in Material Icon Theme and vscode-icons, the folder drawn in each theme's own style. Agree once: they follow you into the other theme, onto your other machines, into remote windows and through updates.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, Courier File Icons takes the folder vscode-icons reads custom icons from out of your own settings only, never out of the workspace's, so the workspace cannot choose where Courier's icons are written.

commands.title: Show Courier's Icons in the File Icon Theme
Remove Courier's Icons from the File Icon Theme

courier.fileIcons.offer.markdownDescription: Offer once, in a Courier project, to show Courier's own icons for `courier.config.ts`, `courier.mocks.ts` and `.courier` when the icon theme in use is Material Icon Theme or vscode-icons — as the editor starts, or when you pick such a theme. Once you agree in one theme, the icons go into the other by themselves when you pick it. Off: run **Courier: Show Courier's Icons in the File Icon Theme** when you want them.
